sources.provider: NOAA MRMS / NOAA Open Data Dissemination
sources.space_time: Approximately 1-km regular latitude/longitude grid; 0–1 hour accumulation in mm; current aggregation contract rejects other intervals.
sources.latency: First-publication and basin-specific valid-to-receipt latency not measured. Archive HTTP Date, Last-Modified, ETag, retrieval time and valid interval separately.
sources.historical_archive: Current product acquisition implemented; historical retrieval and complete hourly basin coverage are not yet verified.
sources.quality: qualified; radar and gauge blending, QC, version changes and gauge availability affect estimates; preserve product/version and quality fields
sources.aggregation: USGS NLDI upstream basins at MAUL1 and DENL1, plus their verified nested difference. Cell-center polygon inclusion, cos(latitude) area weighting and an 80% valid-cell gate; geometry and grid hashes retained.
sources.cost: free public NOAA data; GitHub Actions can query recent files and retain only watershed aggregates
sources.live_status: Hosted check 2026-10-25: NLDI returned HTTP 200 for both stations. DENL1 area was 3529.77 km2, MAUL1 4907.96 km2, with DENL1 99.9989% inside MAUL1 (about 0.038 km2 outside). Current MRMS product body downloaded, but cfgrib reported units=unknown, GRIB_units=unknown, shortName=unknown, GRIB_paramId=0 and stepType=instant. The field was rejected; no aggregates were produced or scheduled.
